faqs.q: What is Ferryl 400R anticorrosive white coating?
faqs.a: Ferryl 400R is a white, one-component, flexible coating that dries like paint but stays flexible like plastic. It is made for rubber hoses, electrical cables and standing rigging on deck. It contains rust inhibitors and UV stabilisers, and is applied by brush, roller or spray.

faqs.q: What pack size and part number does Ferryl 400R come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 400R is supplied in one pack, a 12 kg metal drum, under part number IH-FRY-400R-12KG. The SKU is IH-FRY-400R. There is no smaller tin listed, so for small jobs ask us about the quantity you need.

faqs.q: Ferryl 400R white coating or Ferryl 401 transparent coating?
faqs.a: Choose 400R for rubber hoses, cables and standing rigging, where a white finish is wanted. Choose [Ferryl 401](/p/ferryl-401-anticorrosive-transparent-coating) when bare metal such as stainless steel or brass must keep its original look under a clear gloss film.

faqs.q: How do I choose Ferryl 400R for rubber hoses and cables?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that paint does not stick to rubber and cracks off, while grease washes away. 400R is designed to adhere to rubber, flex with it and put a white barrier against sun and salt water. Use it on hydraulic hoses, electrical cables, seals and tubing on deck.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 400R perform on deck?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that the dry film stays flexible, so it does not crack under vibration or movement. It lists chemically active rust inhibitors, UV stabilisers, and resistance to oil, grease, petrol and salt water. Ferryl does not publish figures for film thickness or service life.

faqs.q: Which surfaces can Ferryl 400R white coating be applied to?
faqs.a: The product data lists rubber, steel wire and most surfaces. Typical uses are hydraulic hoses, electrical cables, seals, tubing, and stay, guy, tension and suspension wires. Ferryl states that it adheres to most surfaces. Clean the surface first with Ferryl 404.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 400R have a standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for 400R. What exists is the Ferryl product information sheet, and a safety data sheet that we supply on request. If your project needs a specific approval, tell us and we will ask Ferryl rather than assume one.

faqs.q: What do I use with Ferryl 400R white coating?
faqs.a: Use [Ferryl 404 Dilution & Cleaning Liquid](/p/ferryl-404-dilution-cleaning-liquid) to clean the surface before coating, to thin 400R if you need a different viscosity, and to clean brushes and sprayers afterwards. Hoses to protect are on the [marine hoses](/c/marine-hoses) shelf.

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 400R applied and thinned?
faqs.a: Ferryl 400R is one component and ready to use, applied like paint by brush, roller or spray. Clean the surface with Ferryl 404 first. If a different viscosity is needed, thin with 404, which also cleans the brushes afterwards. Ferryl does not publish a drying time.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 400R used on a vessel?
faqs.a: Ferryl 400R is used on rubber hydraulic hoses, electrical cables, seals and tubing, and on standing rigging such as mast, stay and guy wires. Ferryl states that rubber loses plasticisers to heat, sunlight and salt water, which 400R is meant to slow. See the [anticorrosive coatings shelf](/c/anticorrosive-safety-coatings).

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 400R and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 400R is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. The country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl 400R in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl 400R Anticorrosive White Coating in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm quantity and delivery.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 401 anticorrosive transparent coating?
faqs.a: Ferryl 401 is a clear, glossy, flexible one-component coating with rust inhibitors. It seals metal fittings off from salt water while keeping their original look. It is applied like paint by brush, roller or spray, and comes in a 1 kg metal tin.

faqs.q: What pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl 401 come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 401 comes as a single 1 kg metal tin, part number IH-FRY-401-1KG, or as a pack of 10 x 1 kg tins, part number IH-FRY-401-1KG-X10. The SKU is IH-FRY-401. Quote the part number when you ask for a price.

faqs.q: Ferryl 401 clear coating or Ferryl 400R white coating?
faqs.a: Choose 401 where the metal should stay visible, such as stainless steel, brass or copper fittings. Choose [Ferryl 400R](/p/ferryl-400r-anticorrosive-white-coating) for rubber hoses, cables and rigging wires, where a white flexible film is wanted. Both are one-component and flexible.

faqs.q: How do I choose Ferryl 401 for stainless steel fittings?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that even 316 stainless steel stains and rusts within a few years on an open deck. 401 is chosen when the metal should keep its original appearance: couplings, railings, brackets, signs and portholes. If a part is already rusting, treat it first (see the rust steps).

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 401 perform in salt water and sunlight?
faqs.a: Ferryl states the film is transparent and glossy, stays flexible and does not crack under vibration or movement. It lists rust inhibitors, UV stabilisers, and resistance to oil, grease, petrol and salt water. Ferryl does not publish film thickness or service life figures.

faqs.q: Which metals can Ferryl 401 clear coating be used on?
faqs.a: The product data lists steel, stainless steel, copper, aluminium, brass, light alloys and wood. Ferryl states that it adheres to most surfaces. Typical items are handrails, couplings, pipes and fittings, door hardware, ventilators and instruments. See [fitting plating guidance](/blog/plating-and-corrosion-on-fittings).

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 401 have a standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for 401. The documents available are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Tell us if your job needs a specific approval and we will check with Ferryl.

faqs.q: What should I use before applying Ferryl 401?
faqs.a: Ferryl advises removing rust with Ferrycid, cleaning with [Ferryl 404](/p/ferryl-404-dilution-cleaning-liquid), then coating with 401. 404 also thins 401 and cleans tools. For why dissimilar metals corrode, read [galvanic corrosion in fittings](/blog/galvanic-corrosion-in-fittings).

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 401 applied to a deck fitting?
faqs.a: Ferryl 401 is one component and ready to use, applied like paint by brush, roller or spray. Clean the fitting with Ferryl 404 first, and remove any rust with Ferrycid. 404 thins the coating if needed and cleans the tools. Ferryl does not publish a drying time.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 401 used on a ship or yacht?
faqs.a: Ferryl 401 is used on handrails, couplings, pipes and fittings, door frames and knobs, nuts, engine parts, ventilators, signs, binnacles, portholes, instruments and fixtures. It suits the bright metalwork that goes brown on an open deck. Shelf: [anticorrosive coatings](/c/anticorrosive-safety-coatings).

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 401 made and by whom?
faqs.a: Ferryl 401 is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. The country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East. Ferryl is the maker of the whole coatings range.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl 401 in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl 401 Anticorrosive Transparent Coating in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm quantity and delivery.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 404 Dilution & Cleaning Liquid?
faqs.a: Ferryl 404 is a solvent-based cleaner and thinner. It removes dirt, oil and grease from a surface before coating, thins Ferryl coatings and most solvent-based paints, and cleans brushes, rollers and spray equipment. It comes in a 10 litre metal can.

faqs.q: What pack size and part number is Ferryl 404 sold in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 404 is sold in one pack, a 10 litre metal can, part number IH-FRY-404-10L. The SKU is IH-FRY-404. Quote the part number when you ask for a price or delivery.

faqs.q: Ferryl 404 thinner or a ready-to-use Ferryl coating, which do I need?
faqs.a: They do different jobs. 404 is not a coating: it cleans the surface and thins the coating. Ferryl [400R](/p/ferryl-400r-anticorrosive-white-coating), 401, 502 and 505 are the one-component coatings that form the protective film. Most jobs use both.

faqs.q: How do I choose Ferryl 404 for surface preparation?
faqs.a: Choose 404 when a metal or painted surface carries dirt, oil or grease before coating. Ferryl states that a coating lasts only as long as its grip on the surface, so cleaning first gives the best possible adhesion. It also thins the coating to the viscosity the job needs.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 404 perform as a degreaser and thinner?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that 404 removes dirt, oil and grease for the best possible adhesion, and dilutes Ferryl 400R, 401, 502 and 505 to the viscosity needed. Ferryl does not publish a flash point, VOC figure or dilution ratio for 404, so ask us for the safety data sheet.

faqs.q: Which surfaces and paints can Ferryl 404 be used with?
faqs.a: The product data lists metal and painted surfaces before coating, and painting equipment. It thins Ferryl 400R, 401, 502 and 505, and works as a multipurpose thinner for most solvent-based paints, primers and varnishes. It is a solvent product, so test a small area on delicate finishes.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 404 have a standard or approval?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for 404. The documents available are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Ask for the safety data sheet before storing or using the solvent on board.

faqs.q: Which Ferryl coatings is 404 used with?
faqs.a: 404 is the working partner of all four Ferryl coatings: [400R white](/p/ferryl-400r-anticorrosive-white-coating), [401 transparent](/p/ferryl-401-anticorrosive-transparent-coating), [502 orange-red](/p/ferryl-502-fluorescent-orange-red-safety-coating) and 505 yellow. Use it before, during and after coating.

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 404 applied to a surface?
faqs.a: Ferryl 404 can be applied by brush, rag, spray, pouring or submersion. Use it first to strip dirt, oil and grease, then, if needed, to thin the coating, and finally to clean brushes, rollers and spray equipment. Ferryl does not publish a mixing ratio.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 404 used in marine maintenance?
faqs.a: Ferryl 404 is used in surface preparation on deck and machinery, when thinning Ferryl coatings, and for cleaning painting tools. It is typically bought alongside the coatings on the [anticorrosive and safety coatings](/c/anticorrosive-safety-coatings) shelf.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 404 and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 404 is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. The country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East. Ferryl is the maker of the whole coatings range.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl 404 in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl 404 Dilution & Cleaning Liquid in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm quantity and delivery.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 502 fluorescent orange-red safety coating?
faqs.a: Ferryl 502 is a fluorescent orange-red, one-component, flexible anticorrosive coating. It marks lifeboats, life-saving equipment, fire extinguishers, alarms, exits and crane hooks so they stand out in poor light. It comes in a 1 kg metal tin.

faqs.q: What pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl 502 come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 502 comes as a single 1 kg metal tin, part number IH-FRY-502-1KG, or as a pack of 10 x 1 kg tins, part number IH-FRY-502-1KG-X10. The SKU is IH-FRY-502. Quote the part number when you ask for a price.

faqs.q: Ferryl 502 orange-red or Ferryl 505 yellow safety coating?
faqs.a: Ferryl points to 502 for lifeboats, life-saving gear, fire extinguishers, alarms and emergency exits. For walkways, steps, ladders and zone markings, [Ferryl 505 yellow](/p/ferryl-505-fluorescent-yellow-safety-coating) is the usual choice. Check your flag and class requirements for any regulated marking colour.

faqs.q: How do I choose Ferryl 502 for safety marking?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that ordinary paint is dull in fog, rain and darkness, fades in sun and cracks at sea, while fluorescent orange-red looks far brighter, especially in low light. Choose 502 for equipment and hazards that must be found fast. Confirm any regulated colour with your flag or class.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 502 perform at sea?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that the film stays flexible and does not crack under vibration, and that UV stabilisers hold the colour intensity. It lists rust inhibitors and resistance to oil, grease, petrol and salt water. Ferryl does not publish colour-fastness or service-life figures.

faqs.q: Which surfaces can Ferryl 502 be applied to?
faqs.a: The product data lists steel, plastic, fibreglass and painted surfaces. Ferryl states that it adheres to most surfaces. Clean the surface with [Ferryl 404](/p/ferryl-404-dilution-cleaning-liquid) first so the coating grips. The film also protects the steel underneath against rust.

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 502 have a standard or approval for marking colour?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for 502, and none for its colour. The documents available are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Check your flag and class requirements for any marking colour that is regulated.

faqs.q: What do I use with Ferryl 502 safety coating?
faqs.a: Use [Ferryl 404](/p/ferryl-404-dilution-cleaning-liquid) to clean the surface, thin the coating and clean tools. Pair it with [Ferryl 505 yellow](/p/ferryl-505-fluorescent-yellow-safety-coating) for walkways and steps. The full range is on the [anticorrosive and safety coatings](/c/anticorrosive-safety-coatings) shelf.

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 502 applied?
faqs.a: Ferryl 502 is one component and ready to use, applied like paint by brush, roller or spray. Clean the surface with Ferryl 404 first. 404 also thins the coating if a different viscosity is needed and cleans the tools. Ferryl does not publish a drying time.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 502 used on board?
faqs.a: Ferryl 502 is used on lifeboats and life-saving equipment, buoys, fire extinguishers, alarms and warnings, emergency exits and doorways, the bridge, low beams and steps, and crane hooks. Ferryl suggests it wherever safety equipment must stand out in poor light.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 502 and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 502 is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. The country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East. Ferryl is the maker of the whole coatings range.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl 502 in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl 502 Fluorescent Orange-Red Safety Coating in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm quantity and delivery.

faqs.q: What is Ferryl 505 fluorescent yellow safety coating?
faqs.a: Ferryl 505 is a fluorescent yellow, one-component, flexible anticorrosive coating for marking steps, ladders, railings, walkways, tripping hazards and crane hooks. It comes in a 1 kg metal tin, and is the yellow partner to Ferryl 502.

faqs.q: What pack sizes and part numbers does Ferryl 505 come in?
faqs.a: Ferryl 505 comes as a single 1 kg metal tin, part number IH-FRY-505-1KG, or as a pack of 10 x 1 kg tins, part number IH-FRY-505-1KG-X10. The SKU is IH-FRY-505. Quote the part number when you ask for a price.

faqs.q: Ferryl 505 yellow or Ferryl 502 orange-red safety coating?
faqs.a: Choose 505 for steps, ladders, railings, walkways, tripping hazards and zone markings. Choose [Ferryl 502 orange-red](/p/ferryl-502-fluorescent-orange-red-safety-coating) for lifeboats, life-saving gear, fire extinguishers and emergency exits. Check your flag and class requirements for any regulated colour.

faqs.q: How do I choose Ferryl 505 for hazard marking?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that fluorescent yellow stands out most in low light such as fog, storms, dusk and badly lit spaces, when trip and head-strike hazards matter most. Choose 505 for walkways, steps, low beams and hatches. Confirm any regulated marking colour with your flag or class.

faqs.q: How does Ferryl 505 perform on deck?
faqs.a: Ferryl states that the film stays flexible, so it does not crack and peel like paint, and that UV stabilisers hold the colour intensity. It lists rust inhibitors and resistance to oil, grease, petrol and salt water. Ferryl does not publish colour-fastness or service-life figures.

faqs.q: Which surfaces can Ferryl 505 yellow coating be used on?
faqs.a: The product data lists steel, plastic, fibreglass and painted surfaces. Ferryl states that it adheres to most surfaces, and that the film protects the steel against rust. Clean the surface first with [Ferryl 404](/p/ferryl-404-dilution-cleaning-liquid).

faqs.q: Does Ferryl 505 have a standard or approval for marking colour?
faqs.a: Ferryl publishes no standard or approval for 505, and none for its colour. The documents available are the Ferryl product information sheet and a safety data sheet, which we supply on request. Check your flag and class requirements for any marking colour that is regulated.

faqs.q: What do I use with Ferryl 505 safety coating?
faqs.a: Use [Ferryl 404](/p/ferryl-404-dilution-cleaning-liquid) to clean the surface, thin the coating and clean tools. For life-saving equipment and exits use [Ferryl 502](/p/ferryl-502-fluorescent-orange-red-safety-coating). The range is on the [anticorrosive and safety coatings](/c/anticorrosive-safety-coatings) shelf.

faqs.q: How is Ferryl 505 applied?
faqs.a: Ferryl 505 is one component and ready to use, applied like paint by brush, roller or spray. Clean the surface with Ferryl 404 first. 404 also thins the coating if a different viscosity is needed and cleans the tools. Ferryl does not publish a drying time.

faqs.q: Where is Ferryl 505 used on a vessel?
faqs.a: Ferryl 505 is used on steps and ladders, railings, walkways, tripping hazards, hatches, low beams, zone markings, numbering, storage areas and crane hooks. It suits places where people could trip or strike their head in poor light.

faqs.q: Who makes Ferryl 505 and where is it made?
faqs.a: Ferryl 505 is made in Germany by Ferryl Deutschland GmbH and sold through Ferryl Sales Ltd, Isle of Man. The country of origin is Germany. Indus Hydraulics distributes Ferryl marine maintenance products in the Middle East. Ferryl is the maker of the whole coatings range.

faqs.q: Is Ferryl 505 in stock and how do I order it?
faqs.a: We keep Ferryl 505 Fluorescent Yellow Safety Coating in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the product, pack size, quantity and delivery port or address, and we confirm quantity and delivery.
